description: Ranked top-chart lists per storefront. iOS collections: topfreeapplications, toppaidapplications, topgrossingapplications, newapplications (+ ipad variants). Android: topselling_free, topselling_paid, topgrossing, new_free, new_paid.

category.description: Optional category id, e.g. '6018' (iOS Books) or 'GAME' (Android).

collection.description: Chart name. Defaults to topfreeapplications (iOS) / topselling_free (Android).

country.description: ISO-2 storefront code, e.g. us, gb, de, jp. Defaults to us.

store.description: Store to query: "ios" (Apple App Store) or "android" (Google Play).

name: top_charts
title: Top charts
